[[Lieutenant]] '''Wion Dillems''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from [[Yelsain]] who embraced technology so that he could fly at unimaginable speeds. Joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] he was stationed onboard the ''[[Profundity]]'', the mobile [[flagship]] of [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]]. After [[pilot]] [[Puck Naeco]] broke his [[Limb|ankle]], Dillems stood in for him as [[Green Twelve]] in [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], who were based in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. While on Yavin, Dillems was included in a proposed flight schedule put together by [[Colonel]] [[Bandwin Cor]].

By [[1 BBY]], Dillems had downed or destroyed 180 enemy [[Starship|craft]] and was considered an [[ace]]. He attended a meeting in the Great Temple where the [[Alliance High Command]] refused to support a plan to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] from the [[planet]] [[Scarif]]; however, after a [[Rogue One|group]] of rogue rebels traveled to Scarif anyway, Dillems was part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] scrambled to support them. He and the rest of Green Squadron then engaged [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy|forces]] above Scarif.

==Biography==
===The forester of Green Squadron===
[[File:RebelPilots-BaseSeries4.png|thumb|right|250px|Wion Dillems stands with Major Ralo Surrel and Harb Binli.]]
Wion Dillems was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who grew up in the wilds of [[Yelsain]] among the rustic [[Tree Dweller tribes]] that lived in the dense [[forest]]s. Joining the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="UVG" /> he became a dangerous hunter of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Starship|craft]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> and by [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> was an [[ace]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> who had shot down or destroyed at least 180 enemies<ref name="Killcount">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' states that each "V" in a [[Color|yellow]] or red circle on Wion Dillems's [[K-22995 light flight helmet|helmet]] represents 20 enemy craft shot down or destroyed. In ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' nine such symbols are visible on his [[helmet]] which would represent 180 craft.</ref> and attained the rank of [[lieutenant]].<ref name="RF">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> Dillems was usually assigned to the ''[[Profundity]]'', the [[flagship]] of [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]], which was stationed with the ever-mobile [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]. However, after the [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] [[Puck Naeco]] broke his [[Limb|ankle]] during a rough landing, Dillems stepped in<ref name="UVG" /> as an emergency replacement<ref name="Geektionary" /> to fill the vacant [[Green Twelve]] slot in the [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] of the [[Massassi Group]], who were based in the [[Great Temple]] headquarters of the Alliance on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="UVG" />

While Dillems was flying with Green Squadron, [[Colonel]] [[Bandwin Cor]] of [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] included him on a proposed flight patrol schedule. The schedule was for a mission along the patrol route between Yavin and the [[Gordian Trace Relays]], visiting them in the order [[Core Worlds|coreward]], spinward, then [[Outer Rim Territories|rimward]]. The [[pilot]]s would be tasked with performing a flyby of the surrounding [[Realspace|space]] and then performing a close uplink of passive relay recordings once they had verified it was all clear. Dillems was placed in shift cycle three on the schedule, flying alongside [[Green Four]], Lieutenant [[Attico Wred]]. The proposed schedule was sent by [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] to [[Mon Mothma]], head of the Alliance, and ultimately ended up preserved in the collection of documents that became known as [[The Rebel Files]].<ref name="RF" />

===The Battle of Scarif===
[[File:WionDillemsYavin.png|thumb|left|300px|Wion Dillems was based in the Great Temple on Yavin 4 while flying with Green Squadron.]]
After the rebel agent [[Jyn Erso]] returned to Yavin 4 with news of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], a meeting was held in the Great Temple to discuss what the Alliance should do with this information. Willems attended the meeting and stood near [[Blue Leader]] [[Antoc Merrick]] while the [[Alliance High Command]] discussed Erso's proposal to travel to the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] and steal the [[Death Star plans]], which would reveal a weakness in the [[Death Star]] that the Alliance could exploit. Ultimately the plan failed to garner unanimous support from those present, and so the meeting disbanded with a decision not to go through with it. Erso, however, led a rogue [[Rogue One|squad]] on an unauthorized mission to Scarif anyway.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Once the rebels on Yavin 4 learned of what was happening on Scarif, the Alliance Fleet was scrambled to provide support,<ref name="Rogue One" /> including Dillems and the rest of Green Squadron.<ref name="UVG" /> Upon the arrival of the [[fleet]] in the [[Scarif system]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> Green Squadron engaged the Imperial forces in orbit,<ref name="Geektionary" /> fighting alongside [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] as they defended the fleet. Ultimately, the Alliance managed to successfully transmit the plans from the surface of Scarif and escape with them, although they took heavy casualties in the process.<ref name="Rogue One" /> In total, fifteen of the fighters from Yavin 4 were destroyed, mostly from Red or Blue Squadrons.<ref name="Grounded">{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Unlike most of his compatriots, Dillems was drawn to technology because it afforded him the ability to fly at unimaginable speeds<ref name="UVG" /> and so embraced technological mastery of vehicles. Dillems had long [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]] and a moustache<ref name="Geektionary" /> with light skin and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="UVG" />

==Equipment==
[[File:WionDillemsHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Wion Dillems' flight helmet]]
Wion Dillems wore an orange [[flight suit]] with two [[code cylinder]]s in the left sleeve, a white [[flak vest]], and a [[Diagnostech life support unit]]. He also wore a black [[belt]] and [[flight glove]]s equipped with a wrist-mounted [[comlink]] and beacon.<ref name="UVG" /> Dillems marked his personal score of downed or destroyed enemy vehicles on his [[K-22995 light flight helmet]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> with a [[victory decal]]<ref name="Helmets">{{SW|url=games-apps/rogue-one-helmet-creator|text=''Rogue One'' Helmet Creator|int=Rogue One Helmet Creator|nolive=1}}</ref> in a red or yellow circle for every twenty craft.<ref name="Geektionary" /> By the [[time]] he flew at Scarif, there were at least nine decals on his [[helmet]], which also had a red and white chequered pattern above the visor, red markings down the back, and a black symbol on each side.<ref name="UVG" /> The chequred pattern matched that worn by fellow rebel pilots [[Heff Tobber]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> [[Puck Naeco]],<ref name="Pilots">{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}}</ref><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and [[Wes Janson]].<ref name="Janson">{{Databank|wes-janson|Wes Janson}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wion Dillems was portrayed uncredited by [[Dion Williams]]<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=Skywalkersignings-uk-101887251657960|url=watch/?v=852735408799376|name=Skywalkersignings uk|date=2020-10-29|archiveurl=https://archive.md/X8iPq}}</ref> in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Prior to the film's release on [[December 16]], [[2016]],<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Dillems was pictured on a card titled "Rebel Pilots" that was added to the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app<ref name="Topps">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 4|cardname=Rebel Pilots (trio)}}</ref> on [[October 28]], 2016.<ref name="release">{{ToppsDigital|subdomain=www|url=swcardtrader/article/5813d3d37b941e34faed1ed8|text=Base Series 4 Has Arrived!|date=2016-10-28}}</ref>
